description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: The page number from which to start displaying results. Minimum value: 1.

description.zh:
场景联动规则日志的结束时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

> 最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志。
description.en:
The end time of the scene orchestration rule log, in seconds, specified as a UNIX timestamp.

> You can query rule execution logs from up to the past 30 days.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass it for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10。
description.en: The number of records displayed per page in the returned results. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用[QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~)接口获取场景联动规则ID。
description.en: The scene orchestration rule ID. Call the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) API to obtain the rule ID.

description.zh:
场景联动规则日志的开始时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

> 最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志。
description.en:
The start time of the scene orchestration rule log, in seconds, specified as a UNIX timestamp.

> You can query rule execution logs from up to the past 30 days.

description.zh: 场景联动规则日志的轨迹ID。调用[QuerySummarySceneRuleLog](~~169511~~)接口获取该ID。
description.en: The trace ID of the scene orchestration rule log. Call the [QuerySummarySceneRuleLog](~~169511~~) API to obtain this ID.

title.zh: 查看场景联动规则日志的详细信息
title.en: View detailed information of scene orchestration rule logs

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API under a single Alibaba Cloud account is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
